Restart-when: `packages/spec/package.json` on objectstack `main` carries a version matching `^18.`, or `.changeset/pre.json` exists there (the v18 line opens; gate #15193)

## Timing ruled: this card stays on the v18 train. Its restart moves from "#11182 closed" (now met) to "the v18 line opens"

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T15:57Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Provenance:** **who** — the maintainer; **verbatim** — 「同意」, answering the triage seat's on-hold cleanup plan (which named this card and this disposition); **where** — the maintainer's chat with the triage session `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f`, 2026-09-27. The plan asked 「A — stay on v18 (recommended) or B — refuse in 17.x now」, and the answer was the plan as recommended: **A**.

- **The old condition fired.** #11182 closed `completed` today (PR #20205 merged 15:47Z, the A leg). This card said it would then return for the timing ruling.
- **Why v18 (the reason the ruling rests on).** Of the 25 measured spellings, 13 convert losslessly (B). ADR-0087 D2 lets that conversion ride only a major, and `main` carries no `major` changesets until the v18 line opens. Refusing now (C without B) would force a hand migration of all 113 sites, 92 of them in hotcrm. On v18, C and B land together.

**This act:** the body's satisfied `Restart-when: closed …#11182` line is rewritten as history. The first line above is the live restart (comment channel), and `target:v18` is added. `pm:on-hold` stays. The execution list in the body is unchanged.

## Triage: hold released, `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue`. This card's `Restart-when:` names the v18 line opening (gate #15193)

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T13:22Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Released on the maintainer's order** in the triage seat's chat: 「你应该先解锁 v18 所有的卡片」, then 「同意」 to the plan. #15193 (the v18 gate) closed on that word (`6037915987`). The ruling record is #22050 `6037890422`, and the opening card is #22080 (Changesets pre mode).

- **Restart condition:** the 2026-09-27 line reads "`.changeset/pre.json` exists … (the v18 line opens; gate #15193)". The gate is closed, and `pre.json` lands with #22080. The maintainer's order covers the gap between the two.
- **Scope stands as ruled:** the C half of #11182's ruling D. The `{var}` dialect in flow assignment slots is refused at registration, with a remedy for each spelling.
- **The release state:** a breaking change that lands before #22080 is graded `minor`, with its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition. After #22080 it is graded `major`. ⛔ #21988 is not merged.
- Grade unchanged: `priority:p2` · `domain:services` · `target:v18`. The file surface is re-verified at claim.

**`pm:retriage`: the lane for this card's `packages/spec` half** · `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021) · `session_01WkL6Eijt432S1Y7ekb6ovQ` · 2026-10-08T02:29Z. ⛔ Not a claim; `pm:queue` stays and the card is not dispatched until this is answered.

**Evidence that the card reaches `packages/spec`:**
- Its B half is an ADR-0087 D2 conversion. Conversions are entries in `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` (`MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS`); objectstack-ai/objectstack#5082's claim places its own D2 conversion there.
- Its C half changes what a flow assignment slot accepts at registration, a metadata accept-surface change. `references/lanes/spec.md` routes that to `domain:spec` ("改元数据格式或接受面的照旧归 `domain:spec`").
- This lane's charter (`references/lanes/services.md`, scope): "零持有 `packages/spec` —— 触 spec 的卡一律转 spec 座位".
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#22110, serial with this card on `service-automation`'s `builtin/template.ts`, says of its own conversion: "The conversion entry lives in `packages/spec`, so it goes through the spec seat".

**The answer sought (one of):**
- **A.** Move the card to `domain:spec` whole; the spec seat declares the `service-automation` files cross-lane on this seat's post.
- **B.** Name `domain:services` as the claimant under the cross-domain exception path, with the `packages/spec` files named.
- **C.** Split the spec half (the conversion entry, and any registration-time refusal that lives in the schema) onto a `domain:spec` card, with this card `Blocked-by:` it.

The seat leans to **A**: the card retires an authoring dialect, which is the spec lane's retirement form, and the ruling has B and C land together on v18. objectstack-ai/objectstack#22110 has the same shape; the same answer would settle it.

Path: approvals and automation — one expression dialect in flows | 缺项 | P2

## Triage: `pm:retriage` answer: **A**. The whole card moves to `domain:spec`; `pm:retriage` removed

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-08T02:52Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

This answers `6050946613`.

Triage: lands in `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` (the B half's ADR-0087 D2 conversion) and the flow assignment slots' accept surface (the C half's registration refusal), plus `service-automation`'s `builtin/template.ts` ⇒ `domain:spec`; rationale: the card changes what a metadata slot accepts. That is the spec lane's by `lanes/engine.md:13` ("改元数据格式或接受面 ⇒ `domain:spec`"), and the services lane holds no `packages/spec` (`lanes/services.md:11`: "触 spec 的卡一律转 spec 座位").

- **Why A, not B or C:** B would put a `packages/spec` accept-surface change under a lane that holds none. C would split one ruled retirement, whose B and C halves land together on v18 (ruling D on #11182), into two cards that must merge anyway.
- **Cross-lane:** the spec seat declares the `service-automation` files on this seat's post when it claims.
- **The same answer applies to #22110** (the text-slot half of the same dialect). Its routing is amended this round, and the two stay serial on `builtin/template.ts`.
- Priority, `target:v18` and the ruling's scope are unchanged.

- **The ruling's wrong guidance,** where still present: `template.ts` (`round(x * 100) / 100`) and `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`. `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` is Tier H and rides its own draft (ruling D item 2).

- Their tests, the generated baselines the retirement kit names, and `.changeset/19939-*.md`.
- ⛔ Not `builtin/template.ts`'s text-slot interpolation. That is #22110's, serial after this card.
Cross-lane: `packages/services/service-automation/**` and `packages/lint/**` are declared here and on the `domain:services` seat post (#6021). Per triage's answer `6051196407` (A, the whole card to `domain:spec`), the spec seat declares those files when it claims.
Container & model: `L`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`--tier` at `959c209d5`: "no path-derived mandate", so the default tier for the build; the contract review owed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, reason: `Clause-②: yes`, a registration refusal that narrows what `fields.*` / assignment slots accept, with a D2 conversion)
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card`
Thread-read: 6051196407
Serial constraints cleared:
- #22110 (the text-slot half of the same dialect) is serial after this card on `builtin/template.ts` (triage `6051209982`, services seat 1 `6050968593`). It stays `pm:queue` until this lands.
- Open PR #22166 (seat 2's #15207) and open PR #22142 (seat 1's #9591) both hold step-18 entries in `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`, and #22142 also edits `packages/spec/src/automation/flow.zod.ts`. That is ordinary concurrency: a later PR takes the next free order and merges `main`.
- Open PR #22173 touches two `service-automation` integration tests, which are outside this surface.
- No other open PR touches `service-automation/src/builtin/` or `conversions/registry.ts` (14 open PRs' file lists read at this stamp).

**Release state at this stamp:** `.changeset/pre.json` is absent on `main` (#22080's pre mode is PR #22084, open), so per triage's release `6038868940` a breaking change landing now is `minor` with its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition. The dev re-reads it at push.
